name: cvar-unhide-s2-citadel
build_toolchain: MSVC 19.38.33134.0, x64 Release, static CRT, C++20
notes: Locally built from the pinned upstream source and SDK with the included patches. The fix removes the two owned commands on Disconnect and corrects SDK interface-storage clearing; no cvar, camera, rendering or assertion behavior is changed. The upstream project does not endorse this build. The unmodified upstream release binary hash is recorded for provenance. The upstream full gameinfo.gi is intentionally not bundled or installed. Dolly backs up the current local gameinfo bytes and temporarily mounts the DLL via its SearchPaths; it restores after plugin initialization or game exit, with journaled crash recovery. The standard citadel game identity is retained. Release binary compatibility with current Deadlock must be verified on Windows.
